results: An upstream revision does not replace the displayed text
Temporary origin failure returns the identified previous version without advancing checkedAt or resetting its position
Reopening adopts the corrected text and resets only the current reading position
Bookshelf reopening preserves favorites and completion history while resetting the incompatible position
Real offline mode can reopen saved legacy v2 text and preserve its unidentified old position
The first identified online version migrates v2 to v3 and resets an unknown legacy position
Confirmed withdrawal invalidates local text and prevents subsequent offline resurrection
